about.intro: Traveling the world as digital nomads since 2022, we book our stays exactly like your customers do: inspired by social media. We bring this authentic guest perspective into our work.
about.outro: Your dream team for direct communication and a strong digital presence – no anonymous agency structures.

leistungen.title: Everything you need.
leistungen.intro: We offer a complete Done-For-You social media management. You provide the raw footage, we handle the strategy, content, posting, and community. We turn your profile into a daily inspiration for your dream guests.

tabs.label: Strategy & Research
tabs.text: We define your positioning and target audience. Through Viral Market Research, we analyze what captivates the travel industry. A dedicated voice-style guide ensures 100% authenticity.

tabs.label: Content & Design
tabs.text: High-End Editing for Reels and Stories. We write scripts that evoke emotions rather than sounding like ads. With our Guided Filming Session (incl. setup & shot list), you can batch-film your monthly content in just 2–3 hours.

tabs.label: Publishing & Community
tabs.text: We schedule all posts in advance (Strategic Upload). Plus active Community Management: We reply to followers, build genuine relationships, and pre-qualify serious booking inquiries.

tabs.label: Analysis & Sparring
tabs.text: Your Content Command Center: A central dashboard for calendars, approvals, and performance reports. We optimize success in monthly strategy sessions. Direct WhatsApp support included.

extras.label: Branding & graphic design
extras.text: Your brand doesn't have consistent branding yet? No problem. We create a clear brand kit with logo, colours, fonts and feed templates, for your website or print media alike. Everything cohesive and a perfect fit for your company.

extras.label: Landing pages
extras.text: Is your website outdated or in need of a glow-up? Gladly! We design and build your new landing page – with a clear structure, fitting copy, modern design and an integrated contact or booking option.

extras.label: On-site content shoots
extras.text: Don't feel confident shooting content yourself? In the Saxony region we're happy to come to your company for a content day. Outside our area? Then we send videographers and photographers from our network. In just one day you get the material for the next three months.

extras.label: LinkedIn management
extras.text: LinkedIn is still a grey area for you, but you'd like to use its potential? We set up your LinkedIn profile, develop a sound strategy and profile optimisation, and write your posts. Ideal for B2B contacts and business partners.

extras.label: Paid ads
extras.text: Have you tried Meta ads but burned more money than you earned? We boost your strongest posts with targeted paid advertising. With a smart paid-ads strategy we generate quality leads for your company.

extras.label: Social media consulting
extras.text: You only need the foundation or want to train one of your employees? Together we build your social media strategy. Independent of our standard packages we offer a three-month intensive consulting programme, in which we develop the strategy and enable you to become a social media expert yourself. We give you the complete toolkit.

steps.title: Deep-Dive Onboarding
steps.text: Questionnaire & kick-off call for your 90-day strategy.

steps.title: Viral Market Research
steps.text: We analyze what kind of content currently inspires your market.

steps.title: Scripts & Guided Filming
steps.text: We provide scripts – you film everything in just 2–3 hours/month.

steps.title: High-End Editing
steps.text: We edit and design. You approve via a 1-click dashboard.

steps.title: Strategic Upload
steps.text: We post your content at the optimal times.

steps.title: Community & Analysis
steps.text: We engage with your guests and continuously optimize the strategy.

fit.title: Are we a match?
yes: You are willing to show your face on camera.
You can invest approx. 2-3 hours a month for filming.
You want to build your brand long-term (it's a marathon, not a sprint).
no: No one from your team wants to be on camera.
You see social media purely as a sales platform.
